title: Zenit upset CSKA in Moscow to claim the title
description: CSKA - Zenit 75-81 Zenit have been crowned VTB League champions tonight. They upset CSKA in Moscow to claim the trophy. CSKA was trailing by 2 points at halftime but managed to get 6-point lead after three quarters before a 25-13 charge of Zenit, which allowed them to win the game. They made 23-of-25 free shots (92.0 percent) during the game. It was a great evening for American power forward Jordan Mickey (203-1994, college: LSU) who led his team to a victory scoring 19 points and 9 rebounds. His fellow American import Jordan Loyd (193-1993, college: Indianapolis) helped adding 17 points, 6 rebounds and 6 assists. At the losing side Serbian center Nikola Milutinov (213-1994, agency: Octagon Europe) responded with a double-double by scoring 16 points and 17 rebounds and American point guard Casper Ware (178-1990, college: LBSU) scored 17 points and 6 assists.
